events.decision: Two items from the intent check (brand/margin filters, catch-all route) were already correctly implemented in the codebase. The scope was refocused on the four remaining issues found during audit: ISV calculator not wired, text search input unconnected, Searches stats hardcoded, and bare href navigation links.
events.rationale: The project profile used to generate the intent check was out of date. A live read of AlertHistory.jsx (lines 14-16) and App.jsx (line 35) confirmed both items were already in place. Scoping to already-done work would have produced a no-op implementation phase.

events.decision: ISV, totalCost, and marginEst are computed at render time in AlertHistory rather than updating the mock data fields. The existing hardcoded fields in mockAlerts remain in place for reference.
events.rationale: Computing at render time avoids mutating the mock data shape beyond adding the required vehicle spec inputs (cc, co2, fuelType, ageYears). It also means the displayed values automatically reflect spec data changes without additional sync logic.
